mapper.select: SELECT e.event_type, a.patient_nm AS patient_name, a.action_content FROM tb_detection_event e LEFT JOIN tb_event_action a ON a.event_id = e.event_id WHERE e.event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID)
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_event_media WHERE event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_event_media ( event_id, storage_uri, media_st, clip_start_at, clip_end_at, size_bytes ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID), #{storageUri}, 'READY', #{clipStartAt}, #{clipEndAt}, #{sizeBytes} ) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT storage_uri FROM tb_event_media WHERE event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID)

SELECT m.storage_uri FROM tb_event_media m JOIN tb_detection_event e ON e.event_id = m.event_id JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE m.event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID) AND m.media_st = 'READY' AND w.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_event_media m SET viewed_at = now(), viewed_by = #{adminId}, upd_dt = now() FROM tb_detection_event e JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = e.location_id JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE m.event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID) AND e.event_id = m.event_id AND m.media_st = 'READY' AND m.viewed_at IS NULL AND w.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_event_media WHERE event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS UUID)
